description: Na₃AuO₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mnm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.23 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.35 Å. Au is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Au-O bond lengths are 2.01 Å. O is bonded to five Na and one Au atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Au octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-19°.
